details.report:
R1: Reviewer-dispatch now synchronously projects immutable rejected/accepted/closed decisions before lifecycle mutation or child start, preserving monotonic concurrent ordering.
R2: Reviewer role supplies the ledger-backed decision sink, removed post-await decision appends, and latches sink failures as fatal infrastructure before acceptance/start visibility.
R3: Added deterministic barrier coverage for fast rejection, slow invalid completion, simultaneous valid proposals, post-acceptance closure, exact once-only ordered identities/dispositions, one accepted batch, and fatal sink failure.
R4: Exported projectReviewerDispatchOutcome from the execution ledger and replaced role-side outcome traversal while preserving exact identity, target, axis, and settlement checks.
R5: Passed focused concurrency/fatal tests, package lifecycle within the 378-test full suite, full suite, typecheck, standalone npm pack, and git diff check; committed forward as 547580d.
